notes.title: Kanso Release
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!
I am proud to say that Kanso will be released on January the 25th!!


There is one more update for you all before the release (its currently being privately tested), that should come this weekend.
In it there will be the new breathing season, remastered music, and a ton of bug fixes and quality of life tweaks.
I've been working really hard on this to nail all the problems and polish it to where I feel its worthy of your time.

Oh!!
And if you're interested in Kanso on the go, you can now preorder it on iOS here:
https://apps.apple.com/app/id1384257762
Same release date, same features, same support, the full version of Kanso on the go!

notes.title: Progress update
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39078097/f36d7a7c9d4a6a45bed0aa07a67df3c35fe8cdec.png[/img]
Hello everyone, I wanted to give you all a small update to the progress of Kanso.
I've been away for the last month or so for personal health reasons, but I'm starting to make the first steps back to work.

In the coming weeks I will be updating Kanso with mostly bug fixes, polishing and some new features.

The road map (minus timings) looks a little something like this:
[list]
[*] Adding a new infinite play mode.
[*] Adding breathing tool.
[*] Adding some new music.
[*] Adding a lot of new quotes.
[*] Some polishing on the tutorial instructions.
[*] and a wee bit more...
[/list]

Hope you are all well and we will see you soon with updates galore!

notes.title: Icon update
notes.notes:
This week we have a smaller update to let everyone, including me, catch their breath after last weeks big level update.
Have you reached the end yet?

So this week we have a new icon to share along with a several stability fixes and mouse and controller improvements.

Still lots of wee fixes and a few more content updates planed for the coming weeks.  Nothing as big as the 320 levels with the ending sequence, but things to delight non the less.

notes.title: New Content Update!
notes.notes:
[h1]Severity[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39078097/90b14ff4c6b348464b80a1211303356b26ced486.png[/img]
An emotive place that requires stringency in your movements, with a new mix of Seeker and Avoidance Daemons. And with a new shape type to explore in this volcanic world. 

Included in this update:
[list]
[*] 	A new world with 32 new levels are now unlockable

[*] 	Over 5 mins of new ambient music, [url=https://soundcloud.com/dave-sapien/severity-kanso-ost]Preview here![/url]

[*] 	New ‘Whistling’ mechanic to attract Daemons to a position on the Ensô.
	Press the ‘[b]action[/b]’ button on your controller when touching on the analog stick.
	Or, touch the Ensô with your mouse or touch screen.

[*] 	Bug fixes and tweaks
[/list]

notes.title: Kanso Early Access Release
notes.notes:
[h2]Now live on Early Access.
[/h2]
Come join me in my journey to complete Kanso and find a relaxing place to let the world melt away.
This is a low stress, minimal challenge, and soothing game. 
[h2][b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1454650/Kanso/]Get Kanso now[/url][/b][/h2]

[h2]Zen[/h2]
Inspired by the Zen calligraphy practice of [b]Ensô[/b], where every day you paint an uninhibited ink circle on a blank sheet of paper.  
Expressing a physical moment of reflection, focus, and freedom of [b]flow[/b].  
As you move around the circular forms, avoiding the Koi like [b]Daemons[/b].   Kanso is carefully balanced to invoke the flow of this calligraphic practice as a unique gameplay experience. 

[h2]Features[/h2]
[list][*]Over 300 levels [i](128 currently)[/I]
[*]Weekly updates
[*]Unique meditative gameplay
[*]Original soothing music
[*]Cloud Save 
[*]Visual narrative
[*]Designed specifically to manifest relaxation and well being[/list]
[h2][b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1454650/Kanso/]Get Kanso now[/url][/b][/h2]
